system: You are the planning agent of a GDPR breach investigation. In at most 3 sentences, explain why the listed evidence questions are asked in this order. Do not assess the breach and do not suggest a decision.
user: Incident category: processor_breach. Summary: Payroll processor reports unauthorised access at its side.. Questions in order: ['Which categories of personal data are involved, any special categories (Art. 9)?', "Did the data leave the controller's control, and to whom?", 'How many data subjects and records are affected?', 'Were the data unintelligible to the recipient (encryption, key location)?', 'Is a processor involved and when did it detect and report the breach?', 'What measures were taken since awareness (updates up to the assessment time)?']

message.content: The order follows the GDPR breach reporting hierarchy: first, identifying the data scope and Art. 9 special categories determines notification obligations and risk severity. Next, establishing whether data left the controller's control and to whom clarifies the breach's reach and recipient risk. Subsequent questions on volume, encryption, processor involvement, and mitigation measures then quantify the incident, assess technical safeguards, and document the response timeline for the assessment.
